inj.note: Watson exited Sunday's win over the Chargers early with a severe shoulder injury. The cornerback will undergo surgery while on IR, which will end his season. Watson ends the season with 24 tackles (14 solo) and nine passes defensed, including one interception, over seven regular-season games.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Rams CB Jaylen Watson needs season-ending shoulder surgery, Sean Mcvay says
news.d: Rams cornerback Jaylen Watson will need shoulder surgery and be out for the rest of the season.
